The excalidraw file is the source of truth, just pop it into https://excalidraw.com/ if you want to update.

This is current as of 8/6/2025. The flow is constantly being updated, so if this gets too far out of date we should delete it and/or refresh it.

This is meant to be a high level e2e flow. More details to drill down deeper can be found in `session-service.png` or `state-of-eventing.png`.
An existing architecture diagram also already exists at `architecture.png`.
